strategies.name: Direct 8-Stage All-Reduce Loop
strategies.desc: Implements the algorithm exactly as specified with 8 sequential all_reduce calls, each preceded by forward bidiagonal coupling and followed by reverse coupling. Total of 8 all_reduce dispatches on full W*S tensor. Simplest approach with no optimization, maximizing code clarity at the cost of dispatch overhead.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (each rank gets one shard) followed by all_gather to broadcast results. This doubles collective count to 16 dispatches but reduces per-rank communication volume in the scatter phase. Trades dispatch count for potentially better network utilization on large world sizes.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Buffered All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Pre-allocate two buffers and alternate between them across the 8 stages to enable potential hardware-level pipelining. Compute forward coupling, all_reduce, reverse coupling in tight sequence per stage. Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but enables better memory locality and potential overlap of computation with communication.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction (Intra+Inter Node)
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by splitting each all_reduce into intra-node reduction followed by inter-node all_reduce and broadcast back. For num_nodes > 1, uses approximately 24 dispatches (3 per stage: local reduce, cross-node AR, local broadcast) but reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by aggregating within nodes first.

strategies.name: Vectorized Multi-Stage with Single Dispatch
strategies.desc:
Reshape the 8 stages into a batched computation where all 8 iterations' coupling operations are fused into vectorized tensor ops, then attempt a single all_reduce on a concatenated [8, W*S] tensor if memory permits. Reduces to 1 dispatch but increases payload 8x and requires careful indexing to maintain stage dependencies.
